method: Each URL below was requested on 3 November 2026. A published sentence uses a URL only when the opened page supports that sentence. Desk-report figures that failed this test are marked replaced, removed, or could not access, and are not findings.

entries.claim: The Post Office (Horizon System) Offences Act 2024, section 1, quashes convictions for relevant offences.
The statutory Horizon inquiry has published Volume 1 of its final report on human impact and redress.
On 9 January 2024 BBC News reported more than 700 Horizon prosecutions and said quashing legislation was under consideration. It does not support a count of 900 convictions.
Desk report: more than 900 convictions. HTTP 403. Not a finding.
On 3 November 2026 the registry homepage showed 3,870 exonerations and more than 36,226 years lost since 1989. It did not state an official-misconduct share.
DOJ report of 4 March 2015: Ferguson policing and the municipal court were shaped by revenue, and warrants were a routine response to missed appearances and unpaid fines.
TRAC: 3,037,800 active U.S. immigration-court cases pending at the end of September 2026.
OIG report 21-028, January 2021 (revised): Zero Tolerance family-separation planning underestimated the complexity.
UKSC judgment of 15 November 2023, [2023] UKSC 42: majority allowed the appeal; Rwanda removals unlawful under the Human Rights Act until asylum deficiencies were corrected.
Desk report: the Safety of Rwanda Act and a 2025 discontinuation. The contents page timed out. Not a finding.
Desk report: HSBC 2012 penalty of $1.9 billion. The page returned an empty body. Not a finding.
Desk report: Wells Fargo $3 billion settlement. The page returned an empty body. Not a finding.
Desk report: UN cholera apology. The page timed out. Not a finding.
Desk report: UN cholera statement. HTTP 406. Not a finding.
BBC, 23 June 2020: Wirecard’s former chief executive arrested after EY refused to sign the 2019 accounts over a missing €1.9 billion.
Desk report: Odebrecht penalty package. The page returned an empty body. Not a finding.
Desk report: Goldman Sachs 1MDB settlement above $2.9 billion. The page returned an empty body. Not a finding.
Danske Bank’s 19 September 2018 commissioned report: non-resident portfolio flow of approximately EUR 200 billion, and manifestly insufficient AML controls.
ICIJ FinCEN Files page: an investigation of global banks and industrial-scale money laundering. The page does not itself say reports were filed and then ignored.
Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 ranks 182 countries and territories and describes a perceptions index, not a count of corrupt acts.
TI findings note, 10 February 2026: average score 42, 122 countries below 50, authors describe a worsening direction and a decline in accountable leadership.
CPJ’s 2025 killed database explains its work-related coding. It did not display a total of 130. The coding word is CPJ’s, not this site’s grade Confirmed.
Desk report: 130 journalists and media workers killed in 2025. The opened database did not show that total. Not a finding.
Desk report: more than 300 journalists imprisoned for a fifth year. HTTP 404. Not a finding.
RSF publishes a 2026 World Press Freedom Index covering 180 countries. The opened pages did not say the index was at a 25-year low.
Desk report: press freedom at its lowest in 25 years. That sentence was not on the index pages opened. Not a finding.
RSF 2026 Russia page: rank 172 of 180, score 23.15, and independent media banned, blocked, or labelled foreign agents or undesirable organisations since February 2022.
Nobel facts page: Memorial was declared a foreign agent in 2016, the Russian Supreme Court ordered liquidation in 2021, and Memorial is a 2022 peace laureate.
CIVICUS Monitor: more than two billion people, 28 percent of the world population, live in countries rated closed.
Desk report: 3.2 billion people in countries rated closed or repressed. The opened page stated the two-billion / 28 percent closed figure instead. The 3.2 billion figure is not used.
Desk report: CJEU annulled Hungary’s 2017 foreign-funded NGO law. The document page did not return the judgment. Not a finding.
Charity Commission inquiry into Oxfam GB, 11 June 2019: Haiti safeguarding failures, victims not taken seriously enough, official warning for mismanagement.
Government publication page for the Oxfam GB inquiry, published 11 June 2019.
Desk wording that staff paid survivors for sex is not used. The Commission inquiry, which was opened, is the source for the Haiti findings.
Desk report: International Development Committee evidence on sector-wide abuse. HTTP 403. Not a finding.
Page opened. It reports UN approval of unspent funds in July 2017. It does not support a death toll or the moral-versus-legal apology. Those claims are not findings.
KFF survey published 16 June 2022 (2,375 adults). The page links a project titled 100 million people saddled with health-care debt and cites a CFPB estimate of $88 billion on credit reports.
A local news page attributed at least $220 billion to a KFF analysis. The KFF survey page that was opened does not state $220 billion. The figure is not used.
World Bank, 15 October 2024: almost 700 million people, 8.5 percent, live on less than $2.15 a day; the headcount has barely changed since 1990 because of population growth.
Desk report: extreme-poverty rate fell from about 38 percent in 1990 to single digits. That sentence was not on the release. Not a finding.
Desk report: 1.2 billion in informal settlements and 318 million homeless. Those figures were not on the World Cities Report page. Not findings.
IC3 2024 report: 859,532 complaints and $16.6 billion in reported losses, a 33 percent increase in losses from 2023.
IC3 2025 report: 1,008,597 complaints and $20.877 billion in reported losses, a 26 percent increase in losses from 2024.
Desk register pointed at an FBI press page that returned 403. The IC3 PDFs were opened instead and are the sources for the loss figures.

UNODC, 21 July 2026: fundamental restructuring of South-East Asia’s criminal economy; scam losses across East Asia, South-East Asia, Australia and New Zealand estimated at $88.3 billion to $114.1 billion for 2025.
Desk report: about 458,000 homicides in 2021 and a rate of about 5.8 per 100,000. HTTP 406. Not a finding.
Desk report: American scam-centre losses of $10.0 billion in 2024 and $18.2 billion in 2025. HTTP 403. Not a finding.
WEF Global Cybersecurity Outlook 2026: CEOs rank cyber-enabled fraud first; 73 percent of respondents said they or someone in their network was affected during 2025.
Desk register used a secondary summary that returned 429. The Forum’s own outlook page was opened instead.

Verizon DBIR page: human element, including phishing and stolen credentials, remains among the most frequent causes, with vulnerability exploitation and ransomware. The page does not state 60 percent.
Desk report: human element in roughly 60 percent of breaches. Not on the page that opened. Not a finding.
Microsoft, 20 July 2024: a CrowdStrike update affected an estimated 8.5 million Windows devices, less than one percent of Windows machines. Not described as an attack.
National Audit Office, 27 October 2017: WannaCry infected unpatched or unsupported NHS Windows systems and disrupted at least 34 percent of trusts in England.
Desk report: Colonial Pipeline ransom of about $4.4 million. The page returned an empty body. Not a finding.
Desk report: MOVEit cascade. HTTP 403. Not a finding.
Desk report: Change Healthcare ransom and cost. The URL did not return the incident page. Not a finding.
The ITU Facts and Figures 2023 page opened and did not display an offline population. The desk figure of 2.6 billion is not a finding.
Desk report: language models outperforming median adults. HTTP 403. Not a finding.
Oxfam Canada: billionaire wealth grew by $2.8 trillion in 2024, about $7.9 billion a day, as that page states it.
Desk report: billionaire count above 3,000 and wealth up about 81 percent, or $8.2 trillion, since 2020. Not on the page. Not a finding.
Desk report: UBS wealth-stock figures, including a 10.8 percent rise and about one million new millionaires. HTTP 403. Not a finding.
A headline repeated the millionaire sentence. The article body did not load. Not a finding.
Desk report: about $16 billion in 2024 U.S. federal election spending. HTTP 403. Not a finding.

Federal Register, effective 4 November 2021: NSO Group and Candiru added to the Entity List for supplying spyware used to target officials, journalists, businesspeople, activists, academics and embassy workers.
Amnesty, 19 July 2021: a leak of 50,000 phone numbers of potential surveillance targets, not a stated count of confirmed infections, investigated with 17 media organisations.
Desk register Security Lab URL returned 403. Amnesty’s 19 July 2021 press release was opened instead for the same project description.

The Record, 20 October 2025: a Northern District of California order bars NSO from targeting WhatsApp and cuts damages from $168 million to $4 million, concerning about 1,400 users in 2019. The judgment PDF was not opened.
Digital Watch, 22 October 2025: the same order, damages cut, and user count. The two article dates are not averaged, and neither is treated as the docket date.
The judgment PDF linked in the desk register returned 403. Court details are attributed to the two news reports, not to the opinion.
A Treasury ransomware release was opened by mistake and does not sanction NSO Group or Candiru. The sanctions claim is not a finding.
Council of Europe Pegasus report. HTTP 403. Not used.
Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre, the reporting centre linked for people in Canada. No U.S. Federal Trade Commission help link is used.
